title: Verified change candidate materializer
goal: Turn an accepted worker result plus exact base-SHA and patch evidence into an immutable non-applied change candidate.
laws: Mission, job, builder and changed-file identities must match patch evidence.
Base SHA must be exact 40-hex Git identity.
Patch digest is content-bound and immutable.
Candidate status is VERIFIED_CHANGE_CANDIDATE; applyEligible remains false until a later freshness gate.
No canonical apply or product mutation occurs.
